title: Petting Spots
summary: Give a Samoyed a shoulder rub or stroke a tuxedo cat under the chin. Five watercolor animals lean closer, pause, or step away as you discover where each likes to be petted.
summaryZhTW: 輕揉薩摩耶的肩膀，或摸摸黑白貓的下巴。五隻水彩動物有的會靠過來，有的會停下來看你，也可能退開一步。從牠們的小動作，慢慢發現各自喜歡被撫摸的地方。
coverAlt: A hand pets a white Samoyed beside a tuxedo cat, lop rabbit, guinea pig and chestnut horse in a sunlit garden. The title Petting Spots appears in the lower left.
controls: Tap or stroke with a finger or mouse. For keyboard play, open Pet by body area, select a spot, and activate Pet.

approval.note: Creator approved deployment, cover creation and the Possibility catalog addition.
